description:
The Meltline is where the ground stopped being ground and nobody has agreed on a new word for it. Things that used to be people live out there and are working their way back in.

The job is unsentimental and the pay reflects it. You aren't being hired to solve the Meltline. Nobody is solving the Meltline. You're being hired to move it back two hundred metres for a while, which is what everybody out here means by progress.

Take the pills. Take them before, not after. After is a superstition people out here practise instead of the other thing.
name: Over the Meltline

objectives.desc: Kill 2 rad mutants at the Meltline or Vex Hollow
emotes: {who} goes past the last standing marker into ground the maps have given up on.
{who} kills something that had a name eleven years ago and doesn't think about that until later.
{who} checks the dosimeter, decides the number is fine, and is lying to themselves about it.
